description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Zone' within the OpenCart admin namespace. The class contains methods that hook into zone-related actions (add, edit, delete) to generate tasks that update country data accordingly, often by scheduling or executing model interactions. The code appears to be part of an event-driven system where zone modifications trigger country info updates.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Controller class handling zone-related events such as add, edit, and delete, triggering country info update tasks

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Handles the event of adding a zone by scheduling a task to update country info based on the new zone's country_id.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Handles the event of editing a zone, updates country info tasks, and manages country ID changes.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Handles zone deletion by scheduling a task to update the associated country info.
